_about: The Tidebreak ring (RingArena, RingWater, RingLevel; docs/bending_design.md 'Pro-bending', the plan's T3). Every number here, tunable by eye. The long axis is the arena's local X: side 0 at -X, side 1 at +X. s is metres back from the centre into a side. Zones read from the deck's own build, no painted or lit lines (the owner, 2026-10-04): each zone's deck is laid in its own stone or wood.

looks._about: How each part of the deck is laid: kind stone (cut slabs, slab_m square, a little uneven) or boards (planks plank_w wide running along grain x or z, board_m long, joints staggered); tint multiplies the material's own colour; jitter the slab-to-slab or plank-to-plank tint spread.

sockets._about: Stone sockets in the deck (open rules too): a stone sits in each for Shove, Gust lift and the cushion to work on; taken away, another rises refill_s later; RingArena.rebuild puts every one back. [s, z] per side, mirrored.
sockets._hurl: A stone on the deck shoved or lifted (a socket's cannonball, a dropped spike, a kicked-up stone: any flight with the open world's moves.json gust.stone.hurl numbers; RingArena._ring_hurls) flies with these by its kind instead: knock-back ammo, not the open world's 45-110 blows (KITS round 2's soak: earth won on shoved cannonballs). A Stone Form cast and a caught stone sent back keep their own.

water._about: The tank's water (RiverWater's shader, river.gdshader, its own material): the colour of 2 m of clear water over a stone floor, a slow drift, no ice.

surround._about: What stands round the tank: a flagged walk (plaza_side m along the long sides, plaza_end m past the ends) at the deck's height, timber stands of tiers along both long sides, and a stone wall across each end, so the eye stays in the arena.

modes._about: Overlays on the numbers above for a rule set (RingArena.set_mode: the ring's rule set, RingRules.pick_rule_set). A key here replaces the base's; a block (coping, lanterns, piers, curtain) is the overlay's own. classic has none: today's numbers.

stock._about: The % ring's stage (smash_r3 spec v2 §5.1-5.2): the deck where it is, the water 6 m under it in a deep tank 10 m wide on every side, the deck on piers with a stone face (grabbable), no ropes, the tank's edge a curtain of falling water from a rim channel curtain_up_m over the deck (touching it is touching water: out), a pale stone coping along the four lips (proud for the eye, its collider flush) and lanterns on pier heads just outside the lip. A wall (key 4) stands at least wall_lip_clear_m inside every lip. Respawn spouts on the s 12 m line at spout_z.
